stemMd: When did use of the silent study room rise?

options.label: B
options.textMd: At exactly the same rate every week.

options.label: C

options.label: E

explanationMd: The first paragraph says usage rose during examinations. Lower occupancy at other times led to the efficiency debate. The passage does not claim a constant demand pattern.

distractorRationale.a: The room was intended for silent study and meetings were a later proposal.
distractorRationale.e: The room was not permanently closed.
distractorRationale.c: The room was silent by design.
